_comment: All page copy, in the three locales, in one file. The hero headline is not
here on purpose: it is English in every locale and lives in site.config.mjs
so the page and the OG card are built from one string.
Positioning: Moovworks is a platform that teaches applied AI and sells its own
tools. It is not a service studio. We do not build products for others.
The product is not live yet, so every CTA is the waitlist.
Rules for editing: no exclamation marks, no em-dashes, no invented numbers,
no client names, no income promises. pt-BR and pt-PT are written separately,
not converted: they differ on equipa/equipe, guiao/roteiro, ecra/tela, gerund
Voice: plain and specific. Short sentences mixed with longer ones. Avoid the
'not X, Y' slogan pattern, stacked abstractions (system, path, strategy) and
jargon, since one of the promises is 'no jargon'.
Each service carries five parts, and the shape is the sell:
kicker   the mono label on the card
title    what you learn to do
outcome  the one line that makes someone want it
text     the honest paragraph behind the claim
includes what the module covers, as chips

services.title: O que você vai aprender.
services.lead: Quatro coisas, na ordem em que a maioria das pessoas precisa. Cada uma vem com uma ferramenta nossa, que estamos construindo.

items.title: Faça vídeo com IA que vende sem queimar crédito.
items.outcome: Planeje o vídeo antes de pagar para gerar.
items.text: A maioria das pessoas escreve o prompt, espera, gera de novo e paga a cada tentativa. Ensinamos a decidir as cenas, o gancho e o ângulo antes, para você gerar menos e aproveitar mais do que gera. Os ângulos são de nicho, escolhidos porque convertem, e não porque impressionam.

items.title: Transforme o que você sabe em algo que as pessoas compram.
items.outcome: Não é um PDF. É um produto com motivo para custar dinheiro.
items.text: Uma boa ideia vendida como e-book vale pouco. A mesma ideia como ferramenta, experiência guiada ou peça interativa pode valer muito mais. Você aprende a escolher o formato certo para a sua ideia e a construir tudo com IA.

items.title: Chegue nas pessoas certas e faça elas voltarem.
items.outcome: Uma renda que se repete todo mês.
items.text: Viralizar não é sorte, mas também não é garantia. Você aprende a escolher quem atingir, a colocar vídeo e produto na frente dessas pessoas e a trazê-las de volta, para que um bom mês puxe o seguinte.

items.title: Automatize a parte chata, em palavras simples.
items.outcome: Um esquema simples o bastante para explicar a uma criança.
items.text: Sai uma ferramenta nova de IA por dia e não há motivo para acompanhar todas. Mostramos um conjunto pequeno de automações que liga o seu vídeo, o seu produto e a sua audiência, explicado passo a passo, para você parar de se sentir atrasado.

meta.title: Moovworks | Learn AI by building things that sell
meta.description: Learn to make AI video that sells, turn what you know into a product, and automate the boring parts. Made for people who feel late to AI and want to earn from it.

hero.sub: Everyone has an opinion about AI and most of it is noise. Moovworks teaches you to make video that sells, turn your ideas into products, and automate the rest, so you can earn from it without chasing every new tool.

services.title: What you will learn.
services.lead: Four things, in the order most people need them. Each one comes with a tool of ours that we are building.

items.title: Make AI video that sells without burning credits.
items.outcome: Plan the video before you pay to generate it.
items.text: Most people write a prompt, wait, regenerate and pay every time. We teach you to decide the shots, the hook and the angle first, so you generate less and keep more of what you generate. The angles are niche ones, picked because they convert, not because they look impressive.

items.title: Turn what you know into something people buy.
items.outcome: Not a PDF. A product with a reason to cost money.
items.text: A good idea sold as an e-book is worth very little. The same idea as a tool, a guided experience or an interactive piece can be worth a lot more. You learn how to pick the right format for your idea and build it all with AI.

items.title: Reach the right people and bring them back.
items.text: Going viral is not luck, but it is not a promise either. You learn who to aim at, how to put your video and your product in front of them, and how to bring them back, so one good month feeds the next.

items.title: Automate the boring parts, in plain words.
items.outcome: A setup simple enough to explain to a child.
items.text: A new AI tool shows up every day and there is no reason to follow them all. We show you a small set of automations that connect your video, your product and your audience, explained step by step, so you stop feeling behind.

invite.title: Feeling late to AI?
invite.text: Most people are still guessing. Join the waitlist and we will send you a first lesson, then let you in when we open.

process.title: From lost to earning.
process.lead: Learn it, build it, reach people, automate it.

principles.title: Three things we do not do.
principles.lead: The rest of the market does.

items.title: No hype
items.text: We will not promise easy money. You get things you can test and numbers you can check.

items.title: No loose prompts
items.text: Prompting without a plan is the fastest way to lose credits. We plan first.

items.title: No jargon
items.text: If it needs a glossary, we rewrite it.

about.headline: We teach. We do not take client work.
about.text: Moovworks is not an agency and does not build products for other people. We build our own, learn what works, and teach it to you, tools included.

contact.title: Get in early.
contact.text: We are still building. Leave your email and we will send a first lesson now, then let you in when the platform opens.
